card.name: The start of the word acute
card.fires_on: The first piece "Ac" or "AC" of the word acute, when it begins a heading or a condition name. It is seen in warnings and contraindication lists, such as acute renal failure or acute pancreatitis.

modes.label: Section headings
modes.description: "Ac" opens a numbered warning heading such as acute pancreatitis.

modes.label: Capitalized warnings
modes.description: "AC" starts the word in an all-caps boxed warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: THROMBOSIS, RENAL DYSFUNCTION, AND<< AC>>UTE RENAL FAILURE Thromb

modes.label: Lists of conditions
modes.description: "Ac" starts acute in a bulleted contraindication or risk phrase.
modes.example: Benign or malignant liver tumors •<< Ac>>ute liver disease

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "ute", completing the word acute.
card.plain: It spots the first letters of the word acute in warning headings and helps finish the word.
